an10.213:1.1: “Bhikkhus, possessing ten qualities, women are deposited in hell as if brought there.
an10.213:1.13: Possessing these ten qualities, women are deposited in hell as if brought there.
an10.213:2.1: “Bhikkhus, possessing ten qualities, women are deposited in heaven as if brought there.
an10.213:2.3: (1) They abstain from the destruction of life …
an10.213:2.13: Possessing these ten qualities, women are deposited in heaven as if brought there.”
